features: 15W Wireless Output for Fast, Cable-Free Charging-Enjoy the convenience of Magnetic wireless charging with up to 15W output—perfect for quickly powering up your Qi-enabled smartphones and earbuds without the clutter of cables. Just place your device on the surface and let the power flow.

Type-C PD Output for High-Speed Charging-This power bank with Type-C Power Delivery output offers ultra-fast charging for your devices, including smartphones, tablets, and other Type-C gadgets. Whether you're gaming, streaming, or working, stay charged up without long wait times.

Dual Output Ports: USB-A & Type-C for Multi-Device Use- Never choose between devices again—charge two at once with the USB-A and Type-C output ports. Whether it's your phone, Bluetooth headphones, or smartwatch, this power bank can handle them all simultaneously.

LED Battery Indicator to Track Remaining Power-Keep an eye on your battery life with a bright LED indicator that shows real-time power levels. You’ll always know when it’s time to recharge your power bank—no surprises, just full control.

Fast Recharge via Type-C Input Port-No more waiting around to top up your power bank. The Type-C input port allows for faster recharging, so your power bank is ready to go when you are—ideal for travelers and busy professionals.

Travel-Friendly & Universally Compatible Power Bank-Designed with portability in mind, this compact yet powerful power bank fits easily into your bag or pocket. Compatible with Android, iOS, tablets and more—it's your go-to charging solution wherever life takes you.
description: Featuring 15W magnetic wireless output, it allows you to charge Qi-enabled smartphones and earbuds without cables—just snap your device in place and power up effortlessly. The Type-C Power Delivery output delivers ultra-fast charging for your smartphones, tablets, and other USB-C gadgets, making it perfect for work, travel, or daily use. With dual output ports (USB-A & Type-C), you can charge two devices at once, whether it's your phone, smartwatch, or Bluetooth headphones. An easy-to-read LED battery indicator keeps you informed of the remaining power, ensuring you're never caught off guard. When it's time to recharge the power bank itself, the Type-C input port allows for quick and efficient top-ups, so you're always ready to go. Compact, lightweight, and highly portable, this universal power bank fits easily in your pocket or bag, and works seamlessly with Android, iOS, and other USB-powered devices. Whether you're commuting, traveling, or just on a busy day out, this powerful, multi-output power bank is your go-to solution for staying charged anytime, anywhere.
